justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/XmlPrinter.java` and `javaparser-core-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/XmlPrinterTest.java`. `XmlPrinter` is ~244 LOC and is centered on one concern: XML serialization of AST nodes. Its public API is mostly thin overloads/wrappers (`output`, deprecated `output(Node,String,int,StringBuilder)`, `stringWriterOutput`, `outputDocument` for `Writer`/`XMLStreamWriter`, `outputNode`, `print`) around a single recursive serializer (`outputNode`), plus one local runtime-exception wrapper; I do not see multiple independent responsibilities or separate cohesive groups that clearly warrant splitting. The tests cover only XML rendering variants (nodeType on/off, lists, streaming to writer, custom XML), which supports the class being a focused utility rather than an insufficiently modular bundle.
